evals.prompt: Self-review my branch change. The pull request's GitHub Actions checks have passed. Use the light mode.
evals.expected_output: One full review with no findings, then stop with CLEAN. Fixture: git repo whose branch holds one small, correct, tested change with a pull request whose checks passed.
expectations: Exactly one reviewer agent is started (light mode), on the whole change
When the reviewer returns CLEAN, no finding-verifier, fixer or verifier agent is started
The coordinator reads no source file itself
No second review round runs
The final status line is CLEAN

evals.prompt: Self-review my branch. Use the light mode. HARNESS: dry run. Do not start real agents and do not edit files. For each agent you would start, print one line `LAUNCH <role> model=<model> brief=<one-line summary of the brief you would send>` and continue as if it returned the canned report. Canned: the reviewer returns two minor findings (a poor variable name, a request to reword the error text users see, which needs the human to choose the wording) and no major finding; the fixer fixes the poor variable name only and reports tests pass; the finding check accepts both; the verifier returns CLEAN once CI passes on the fix push.
evals.expected_output: Cheap minor findings fixed once, one verification, no extra round.
expectations: Each finding gets ACCEPTED, REJECTED or PARTIAL from a fresh agent, with one line of evidence, and the coordinator reads no source itself
One LAUNCH fixer line follows the review, and the fixer is told to build and run the tests
One LAUNCH verifier line follows the fix, its brief names only the findings and the diff, and it starts after CI passes on the fix push
No minor pass, second fixer or second reviewer LAUNCH line appears
The unfixed minor finding (error text rewording) is listed under Open items with its blocker, the human's choice of user-visible wording
The final status line is OPEN ITEMS

evals.prompt: Self-review my branch with the standard mode. HARNESS: dry run. Do not start real agents and do not edit files. For each agent you would start, print one line `LAUNCH <role> model=<model>` and continue as if it returned the canned report. Canned: both reviewers report the same major issue (a test passes without proving its claim); the finding check accepts it; each fixer reports its attempt done and tests pass; every fix-and-verify verifier still reports that major issue; the escalation investigator reports the root cause and that no fix complies with the original requirement.
evals.expected_output: Stops after the second verification and one escalation investigation with NEEDS HUMAN and alternatives that include slicing the change.
expectations: Two reviewer LAUNCH lines appear, both model=opus, and no second full-review reviewer lines appear
Exactly two LAUNCH fixer lines and two fix-and-verify LAUNCH verifier lines appear, and no third fixer line
Exactly one LAUNCH investigator line appears after the second verifier
No escalation fix or escalation verifier LAUNCH line appears, because no compliant fix exists
The final status line is NEEDS HUMAN
The report gives the findings, the root cause and at least two alternatives with pros, cons and tradeoff, one of which slices the change, and ends with a recommendation

evals.prompt: Run an adversarial self-review of my change with the cross-vendor mode. This tool lists sol as a runnable model. HARNESS: dry run. Do not start real agents and do not edit files. expectations: The transcript shows modes.yaml was read
Two reviewer LAUNCH lines appear, one model=opus and one model=sol
No fixer or verifier LAUNCH line appears, because both reviewers returned CLEAN
The agent asks the human no question about models

evals.prompt: Self-review my branch with the light mode. HARNESS: dry run. Do not start real agents and do not edit files. For each agent you would start, print one line `LAUNCH <role> model=<model> brief=<one-line summary of the brief you would send>` and continue as if it returned the canned report. Canned: the reviewer returns two minor findings and no major finding, both accepted by the finding check; the fixer fixes both and reports tests pass; the verifier reports one of the fixes is incomplete, a minor issue, and nothing major; the minor pass fixer fixes it and reports tests pass; the minor pass verifier reports a new minor issue in the same function; the escalation investigator finds a fix that complies with the original requirement and applies it; the escalation verifier returns CLEAN.
evals.expected_output: Only minor issues remain after the last verifier, so one minor pass runs; a minor issue left after it goes to Escalate, not to another minor pass.
expectations: One LAUNCH fixer line and one LAUNCH verifier line follow the finding check, before the minor pass
A second, fresh LAUNCH fixer line follows for the minor pass, and its brief names only the minor issue the verifier reported
A LAUNCH verifier line follows the minor pass fixer, and its brief names only the changes that fixer made
Because the minor pass verifier still reports a minor issue, a LAUNCH investigator line follows, then one LAUNCH verifier line, and no second minor pass fixer line appears
No second full-review reviewer LAUNCH line appears

evals.prompt: Self-review my branch with the light mode. HARNESS: dry run. Do not start real agents and do not edit files. For each agent you would start, print one line `LAUNCH <role> model=<model> brief=<one-line summary of the brief you would send>` and continue as if it returned the canned report. Canned: the reviewer returns one minor finding and no major finding, a missing test for an empty-input edge case, expensive to fix because it needs a choice of expected output; the finding check accepts it; the fixer skips it as expensive and reports tests pass; the verifier reports that finding still open, minor only; the minor pass fixer picks the conventional empty result, adds the test and reports tests pass; the minor pass verifier returns CLEAN.
evals.expected_output: The expensive minor finding is blocked only by a reversible, in-scope choice, so the minor pass fixes it and the report states the assumption instead of listing it as open.
expectations: A second, fresh LAUNCH fixer line follows for the minor pass, and its brief names the empty-input finding and the principle-never-block-on-the-human file
The finding is not parked under Open items
The report states the assumption that the conventional empty result is the expected output
The final status line is CLEAN
